answer: The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, revoked by a single upheld challenge, idle agents bleed standing. Every claim climbs the anchor of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the ferrous re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. What survives to the cipher is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short.
